video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows beginners how a SQL query with SELECT, FROM and WHERE picks columns and rows out of a table of sales leads

camera_move.what: The camera pans and zooms smoothly to the part of the picture being explained: closer for each clause, then out to show the table, the query and the answer

camera_breathing.what: The whole picture slowly and very slightly zooms in and out in a continuous loop, so held frames do not look frozen

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind a mask

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out just before the next scene

subtitle_bar_fade.what: The subtitle bar fades in when a spoken line starts and fades out when it ends

subtitle_word_reveal.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as they are spoken

table_enter.what: The outline of the table of sales leads draws itself, then the card fills in

rows_enter.what: Each row of the table is revealed from left to right, one row after another

question_marks_enter.what: A violet question mark fades in beside each row, one after another

magnifier_enter.what: A magnifier and a highlight band fade in over the first row

magnifier_step.what: The magnifier and its highlight band slide down from one row to the next

counter_chip_enter.what: A small chip showing the number of rows is revealed from left to right above the table

counter_count.what: The number of rows in the chip counts upward steadily from six to six thousand

row_by_row_exit.what: The magnifier, its highlight band and the row counter fade away

query_card_enter.what: The outline of an empty query card draws itself under the table, then the card fills in

cursor_enter.what: A violet text cursor appears on the first line of the query card

query_typing.what: One line of the query is typed letter by letter

cursor_exit.what: The text cursor fades away once the query is complete

select_headers_light.what: The headers of the name and budget columns turn from pale to violet

city_column_dim.what: The text in the city column fades from navy to pale gray

table_tab_light.what: The table's name tab turns from navy to violet

from_link_draw.what: A violet line draws itself from the word 'leads' in the query up to the table's name tab

from_link_exit.what: The line between the query and the table's name tab fades away

condition_pill_wipe.what: A lavender highlight spreads from left to right behind the condition 'budget > 5000' in the query

test_column_ring_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the budget column of the table

test_band_enter.what: A violet outlined band fades in over the first row of the table

test_band_step.what: The violet band slides down from one row to the next

question_mark_exit.what: The question mark beside a row fades away when the band reaches that row

check_draw.what: A violet check mark draws itself beside a row that passes the test

row_dim.what: The text of a row that fails the test fades from navy to pale gray

test_exit.what: The outline around the budget column and the violet band fade away

result_enter.what: The violet outline of an empty result table draws itself under the query card, then the card fills in

row_chip_enter.what: A white chip with a violet outline fades in around a passing row in the table

row_copy_travel.what: A copy of a passing row's name and budget travels down from the table, behind the query card, into the result table

row_chip_exit.what: The chip around the travelling row fades away as the row lands in the result table

table_restore.what: The pale text and the violet headers of the table return to how they looked at the start

checks_exit.what: The check marks beside the table fade away

unchanged_chip_enter.what: A chip with the word 'unchanged' is revealed from left to right above the table

number_out.what: The number 5000 in the query slides up and fades out

number_in.what: The number 8000 slides up into the place of the old number in the query

number_underline_draw.what: A violet underline draws itself under the new number

result_row_exit.what: The row that no longer passes fades out of the result table

result_row_move_up.what: The row below moves up to close the gap and the result table gets one row shorter

recap_column_bands.what: Lavender bands grow downward from the headers over the name and budget columns

recap_row_outlines.what: Violet outlines draw themselves around the two rows that pass the test

world_exit.what: The tables and the query card fade away to make room for the logo

logo_bars_grow.what: The four logo bars grow upward one after another from left to right

wordmark_reveal.what: The DataEntropy wordmark is revealed from left to right

logo_glow.what: A soft violet glow brightens around the logo bars and settles

tagline_enter.what: The tagline is revealed from left to right under the wordmark

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow in the button nudges to the right once
